UpdateStageDescription: Verify Git, Git LFS and Java 11 are available
UpdateSourceArgs: -c "set -e; echo '=== 2009Scape Prerequisites Check ==='; MISSING=0; if ! command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'ERROR: git is not installed'; MISSING=1; else echo 'Git OK'; fi; if ! command -v git-lfs >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'ERROR: git-lfs is not installed'; MISSING=1; else echo 'Git LFS OK'; fi; if [ ! -x /usr/lib/jvm/temurin-11-jdk-amd64/bin/java ]; then echo 'ERROR: Java 11 (temurin-11-jdk-amd64) not found at expected path'; MISSING=1; else echo 'Java 11 OK'; /usr/lib/jvm/temurin-11-jdk-amd64/bin/java -version 2>&1 | head -n1; fi; if [ $MISSING -ne 0 ]; then echo ''; echo 'One or more required packages are missing.'; echo 'Please run the following on the host as root, then try Update again:'; echo ''; echo '  sudo apt-get update'; echo '  sudo apt-get install -y git git-lfs temurin-11-jdk'; echo ''; echo 'If temurin-11-jdk is not available, use: sudo apt-get install -y openjdk-11-jdk'; echo 'and update the Java path in the template if needed.'; exit 1; fi; echo '=== All prerequisites satisfied ==='"

-c "set -e; echo '=== Cloning 2009Scape ==='; export GIT_HTTP_LOW_SPEED_LIMIT=1000; export GIT_HTTP_LOW_SPEED_TIME=600; git config --global http.postBuffer 524288000; git config --global http.version HTTP/1.1; if [ -d 2009scape/.git ]; then echo 'Repo exists - fetching updates...'; cd 2009scape; git fetch --depth 1 origin master || git fetch origin master; git reset --hard origin/master; git clean -fd; else echo 'Fresh shallow clone...'; for i in 1 2 3; do echo Attempt $i...; if git clone --depth 1 --branch master https://gitlab.com/2009scape/2009scape.git 2009scape; then break; fi; echo 'Clone failed, retrying in 5s...'; rm -rf 2009scape; sleep 5; if [ $i -eq 3 ]; then echo 'All clone attempts failed'; exit 1; fi; done; fi; echo '=== Clone finished ==='"

UpdateStageDescription: Pull LFS files and compile the server with Maven, then place jar in builddir
UpdateSourceArgs: -c "set -e; echo '=== Git LFS + Build ==='; cd 2009scape; git lfs install; git lfs pull; echo 'Running Maven build...'; cd Server; chmod +x mvnw; export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/temurin-11-jdk-amd64; export PATH=\"$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH\"; ./mvnw clean package -DskipTests; echo 'Locating jar...'; mkdir -p ../builddir; JAR=$(find target -name '*-jar-with-dependencies.jar' -o -name 'server*.jar' 2>/dev/null | head -n1); if [ -z \"$JAR\" ]; then echo 'ERROR: No jar found in target/'; ls -la target/ || true; exit 1; fi; echo Copying $JAR to ../builddir/server.jar; cp -f \"$JAR\" ../builddir/server.jar; ls -la ../builddir/; echo '=== LFS + Build finished ==='"
